---
title: "Video Game Duration"
---

An analysis of video game completion times from HowLongToBeat.

```{r}
#| message: false
#| echo: false

library(tidyverse)
library(plotly)

# Load data
games <- read_csv("howlongtobeat.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

# Select top popular games and reshape for comparison
top_games <- games |>
  filter(!is.na(main_story_hours), !is.na(completionist_hours)) |>
  slice_head(n = 12) |>
  select(game_name, `Main Story` = main_story_hours, `Completionist` = completionist_hours) |>
  pivot_longer(cols = c(`Main Story`, `Completionist`), names_to = "Playstyle", values_to = "Hours")

p <- top_games |>
  ggplot(aes(x = reorder(game_name, Hours), y = Hours, fill = Playstyle)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge") +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Main Story" = "#375a7f", "Completionist" = "#e74c3c")) +
  labs(
    title = "Main Story vs. 100% Completionist (Top Games)",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Hours to Beat"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "#222222", color = NA),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "#222222", color = NA),
    text = element_text(color = "#ffffff"),
    axis.text = element_text(color = "#ffffff"),
    legend.background = element_rect(fill = "#222222", color = NA)
  )

ggplotly(p) |>
  layout(
    paper_bgcolor = "#222222",
    plot_bgcolor = "#222222",
    font = list(color = "#ffffff"),
    legend = list(font = list(color = "#ffffff"))
  )
```

## Where Does Your Time Go? (2000–2026)

When aiming for 100% completion, how is player time divided between the main campaign, side content, and completionist grinding?

```{r}
#| message: false
#| echo: false

# Calculate average time breakdown across 2000-2026 titles
breakdown <- games |>
  filter(
    !is.na(release_year),
    release_year >= 2000,
    release_year <= 2026,
    !is.na(main_story_hours),
    !is.na(main_extra_hours),
    !is.na(completionist_hours),
    main_extra_hours >= main_story_hours,
    completionist_hours >= main_extra_hours
  ) |>
  summarize(
    `Main Story` = round(mean(main_story_hours), 1),
    `Side Quests & Extras` = round(mean(main_extra_hours - main_story_hours), 1),
    `100% Collectibles & Secrets` = round(mean(completionist_hours - main_extra_hours), 1)
  ) |>
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "Category", values_to = "Hours")

# Animated interactive donut chart
plot_ly(
  breakdown,
  labels = ~Category,
  values = ~Hours,
  type = "pie",
  hole = 0.58,
  textinfo = "label+percent",
  textposition = "outside",
  marker = list(
    colors = c("#3498db", "#f39c12", "#e74c3c"),
    line = list(color = "#222222", width = 2)
  ),
  hoverinfo = "text",
  hovertext = ~paste0("<b>", Category, "</b><br>Average: ", Hours, " hrs")
) |>
  layout(
    title = list(text = "Average Playtime Distribution (2000–2026)", font = list(color = "#ffffff")),
    paper_bgcolor = "#222222",
    plot_bgcolor = "#222222",
    font = list(color = "#ffffff"),
    showlegend = TRUE,
    legend = list(orientation = "h", x = 0.05, y = -0.15, font = list(color = "#ffffff"))
  )
```
